## Où j'en suis
The SAML ACS endpoint for Fernhill was finished on branch daniel/saml-acs: signature verification with signxml (after python3-saml/xmlsec proved unusable on Alpine), condition checks (audience, recipient, time window with 120 s skew per Fernhill's contract), replay protection in Redis, saml_utils moved to api/auth/saml/verify.py, mypy and full CI green. PR kestrel-analytics/platform#412 is merged; the merge was first refused pending review (branch protection), and the user said no admin, no auto.

- [prochaine-étape] Load Fernhill's staging IdP metadata and send them our staging SP metadata by Wednesday EOD, for the demo Thursday 10:00 New York.
- [prochaine-étape] Create the separate ticket: enforce SSO / disable password login for Fernhill users.
- [essai-raté] python3-saml + xmlsec on Alpine: lxml/xmlsec libxml2 version mismatch, and building lxml from source still failed (Alpine lacks xmlsec1-openssl module) — replaced by signxml.
- [décision] Use signxml, drop python3-saml and xmlsec; write condition checks ourselves; only read attributes from signed_xml (source: t08).
- [décision] Skew tolerance set to 120 s per Fernhill's security questionnaire, not 300 s (source: t12).
- [décision] Password-login changes are out of this PR, separate ticket (source: t12).
